# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A contraction in ATR followed by a breakout above the prior day’s high on expanding volume often captures the start of a short‑term trend. This edge exists because low volatility periods precede expansion, and a volume‑confirmed breakout signals institutional participation, reducing false breakout risk.

## Mechanism

Entry: 20‑period ATR < median of last 20 bars of 50‑period ATR (volatility contraction) AND price closes above prior day’s high (named level) AND volume > 2 × 20‑period average volume → go long at the close.  
Exit: Stop at prior day’s low (named level) or 1.5×ATR, whichever larger; target at 2×risk or trail with a chandelier exit after 1.5×risk.  
Regime filter: Only active when VIX < 15; avoid first/last 15 minutes of session and VIX > 25.
